card.name: Words after identified, found, or discovered
card.fires_on: Small linking words, mostly 'in' or 'on', right after a verb of finding or occurring such as identified, discovered, found, or overdosage. It also appears on a few verbs like 'destroy' or 'rips'.

modes.label: Preposition after finding verb
modes.description: 'in' or 'on' placed right after identified, discovered, found, or overdosage, introducing where or in whom something occurs.
modes.example: In case of inadvertent overdosage<< in>> patients with severely impaired renal and/or hep

modes.label: Other verbs and nouns in news text
modes.description: Scattered harm-related verbs or nouns in general web text about damage or threats.
modes.example: Could hackers<< destroy>> the U.S. power grid?
